prompt: The same dragon character from the reference images, grown up a little: now a young dragon, like a cheerful kid rather than a baby. Keep exactly the same art style, colours, soft flat 2D cel shading and design language: lavender body, pale mint belly with soft horizontal lines, mint wing membranes with lavender edges, warm gold horns and spikes, dark plum eyes with white highlights, rosy cheeks. Changes from the baby: about a third taller, a slightly smaller head compared with the body, a slightly longer neck, longer legs and tail, bigger wings that reach above the shoulders, horns a little longer and more curved, eyes still big and friendly but a touch less round. Still very cute and soft, never scary. Fixed head design: exactly two curved warm gold horns, one on each side of the head, plus one small rounded gold nub centred on top between them; one row of small rounded gold spikes from the back of the head down the spine to the tail tip. Two poses side by side, same size, standing on the same baseline: 1) front view facing the viewer, standing on its back legs, both eyes open; 2) pure side profile facing right, standing on its back legs. Plain flat solid pale background, no shadows, no scenery, no outlines, no text, no labels.
